t.eng-ummmuhammad: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh
Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer
Let them worship the Lord of this House

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِيٓ أَطۡعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعࣲ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنۡ خَوۡفِۭ
ayahs.translit: Allathee atAAamahum min jooAAin waamanahum min khawfin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear
